Features
The powerful design engine lets you compare designs and topologies. You can see the schematic operating values, chars, BOM with footprint and price.
Select
the best products-ICs, MOSFETs and diodes-using extensive filters for topology, features and package.
Design
your power supply with state-of-the-art algorithms and a large component library.
Analyze
your design with physics-based predictive mathematical models in user-friendly charts and operating values tables.
Save
your design or export to PDF and share with your colleagues.
Supported Topologies
WebDesigner+ supports a wide range of topologies to help you find the perfect solution for your power supply design.
